description: Use to find a shared goal to join or recover your memberships after context loss. Discover public spaces or your memberships with mine=true; optional literal q.

cursor.description: Copy returned next_cursor unchanged, keeping filters. For sync copy cursor; latest starts without history.

detail.description: metadata: identifiers; abstract: preview; claims: claim attributes; full: complete body. Default abstract, except get_memory defaults to full.

limit.description: Maximum items per page. Follow next_cursor until absent.

max_tokens.description: Estimated response budget: 3 UTF-8 bytes per token. Increase on BUDGET_TOO_SMALL.

mine.description: Filter to memberships (mine) or pinned entries (pinned). Default false.

q.description: Search text. Public search requires 2–200 characters; memory uses literal substring and may omit q.

name: list_spaces

outputSchema.description: Structured result for list_spaces. Resource fields vary by detail, permissions and operation. Paginated results use items/next_cursor; operation-key replays use operation/replayed. Failures have error and the MCP result has isError=true. See get_help for this tool's contract.
